احتملنا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَلْنَا (iḥtamalnā) /iħ.ta.mal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اُحْتُمِلْنَا (uḥtumilnā) /uħ.tu.mil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
